correctness.rationale: The canonical two-qubit Pauli spread has five commuting triples yielding twenty measurement rays; the other ten maximal commuting triples produce forty distinct stabilizer rays each orthogonal to exactly six measurement rays (profiles 2,2,2,4,4). Independent projector reconstruction and 4×4 determinant checks over the 20 rays found all 1140 triples independent and exactly 600 of 4845 quartets singular; every singular quartet sits in a six-zero stabilizer set, with no uncovered singular four-set. Any vector annihilating four measurement rays is the unique orthogonal complement of a rank-three quartet and therefore one of the forty rays with exactly six zeros. Generic finite-union avoidance realizes exactly 0,1,2 zeros and the basis rays realize three, giving support spectrum 14,17,18,19,20. Uniqueness up to admissible symmetry of complete five MUBs in complex dimension four extends the canonical calculation to all systems. Independent numeric determinant enumeration agrees with exact Gaussian-integer source code; finite ranges are exhaustive, no extrapolation in dimension.
